decisions.rationale: The user decided to version this source with only permissively licensed tasks (verbatim: "drop the tasks with non-standard licenses, version the source, document the decision in gh issue"). Every retained task's skill license is inventoried per task in the release manifest (from SkillHub/skillhub_source_licenses.csv at NVlabs/Skill2Env@a99ad513b438021ed384c60b0a6bdf650afe0a2a): 6,159 retained under Apache-2.0 / MIT / CC-BY-4.0; 3 dropped for non-standard upstream licenses (Apache-2.0 AND OFL-1.1; an EPL-1.0/EPL-2.0 bundle); 1,334 dropped because no skill license could be established at the pinned origin (1,315 without a CSV row, 19 with ambiguous identity). The deterministic checker PASSes the adopted pin (P1) through its declared NVlabs/Skill2Env hop. The prior source pin 6198459210ab98e0c9c4e021b20f50e93c41b9d4 remains banned. An exception does not transfer to a new revision.

decisions.rationale: The user classified these Marin/OpenAthena sources as our own data carrying OpenMDW-1.1 (verbatim: "thoughtcrime and the openathena structure sources should be OpenMDW license because they are our data."). The dataset card declares license: openmdw-1.1 and the official OpenMDW 1.1 text is preserved as the root LICENSE file (OpenMDW/OpenMDW @ b26b32b3), with every task/payload file byte-identical to the configured pin. The raw checker evidence verdict at this pin is PASS P1. An exception does not transfer to a new revision.
